name: Dave Divis
occupation: Sweetwater County assessor (appointed 2018; elected in later cycles; serving through the current term, which ends in January 2027)
education: Bachelor's degree in business administration from the University of Wyoming; permanently certified Wyoming tax appraiser (Green River Star, Apr. 25, 2018)
prior_offices: Sweetwater County assessor (appointed February 2018; later elected). He previously served as chief deputy assessor from 2012 and earlier worked in the Sweetwater County Treasurer's Office beginning in 1991.
background: Dave Divis is the Sweetwater County assessor, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. The Green River Star reported in April 2018, when he sought a first full term after being appointed in February to succeed Pat Drinkle, that he had been chief deputy assessor since 2012, had worked in the Treasurer's Office since 1991 (auto clerk, tax deputy, then office manager), is a University of Wyoming graduate with a bachelor's degree in business administration, and is a permanently certified tax appraiser and a member of the International Association of Assessing Officers. He won the 2022 general election as a Republican. Incoming assessor Marianne Stacey takes office in January 2027.
